name: registry.write
description: Write a typed registry value. Creates the value if it doesn't exist; overwrites if it does. Creates the parent key if missing.

path.description: Registry path in `HKLM\Software\...` form. Created if missing (no separate registry.create_key verb).

value.description: Value name. Empty string for the (Default) value.

data.description: Value data, formatted per `type`. REG_SZ/REG_EXPAND_SZ/REG_LINK: the literal string. REG_DWORD/REG_QWORD: decimal-stringified integer (or `0xHEX`). REG_BINARY: base64. REG_MULTI_SZ: lines separated by `\n` (agent converts to null-separated).

x-output-schema.description: Empty body — wire response is the literal `OK 0`.

x-implementations.name: reg_create_set
x-implementations.description: Win32 `RegCreateKeyExW` (creates parent key if missing; opens with KEY_WRITE) + `RegSetValueExW` (writes the typed value).

windows-modern.description: RegCreateKeyExW + RegSetValueExW. HKLM writes typically require admin; ERR permission_denied without elevation. WoW64 redirection follows the agent's bitness.

windows-classic.description: Same APIs since NT 3.1. NT 4 / 9x agents use RegSetValueExA with ANSI transcoding for string types. Win 9x lacks REG_QWORD (Win NT 5+) and REG_LINK (NT-only) — those return ERR not_supported.
